description: This Java class provides functionality to determine the tenant ID and authentication ID from an MQTT context in an Eclipse Hono adapter. It handles both certificate-based and header-based authentication, and integrates with tenant client factories and tracing spans.

classes.name: MqttContextTenantAndAuthIdProvider
classes.description: A provider class that determines tenant and auth IDs from MQTT context, supporting both certificate and header authentication methods.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves tenant object with auth ID from the MQTT context, handling certificate-based and header-based authentication based on configuration.

methods.name: getTenantViaCert
methods.description: Attempts to extract tenant information from SSL/TLS client certificate if the connection is secured via SSL.

methods.name: getTenantFromAuthHeader
methods.description: Extracts tenant information from MQTT authentication header, if present.
